overview: Based on the published agenda, the D.C. Everest Area School District Board of Education was scheduled to hold a regular meeting to address multiple operational and policy matters as the 2026-2027 school year begins. The meeting was expected to include consent agenda items covering employment changes and financial reports, approval of a ten-year capital plan, review of employee handbook updates, and presentations on summer school results, staff professional development, and facilities planning.

discussions.body: The board was expected to consider employment changes for certified staff in the 2026-2027 school year, with documentation provided in attached employment change documents dated August 18, 2026.
The board was scheduled to review the August 2026 treasury report as part of regular financial oversight of the district's general and other funds.
The board was expected to consider budget transfers and revisions for the 2026-2027 fiscal year, with revision details provided in attached documentation.

The board was scheduled to conduct second reading on nine policies including student supervision and welfare, job descriptions, staff use of personal communication devices, student technology acceptable use, social media use, volunteer oversight, and child abuse and neglect reporting procedures.
Shannon Grabko was scheduled to present regarding the Wisconsin Association of School Boards legislative network and its relevance to the district.
Larry Schaefer from CESA #9 was scheduled to provide a report to the board.

Dr. Casey Nye was scheduled to present multiple items including a district update, facilities study and community survey results, staff professional development initiatives focused on Responsive Classroom, compensation study feedback, website follow-up, and safety training updates.
Dr. Lindell was expected to present a report on the 2026 summer school program, with supporting documentation provided.
Dr. Strike was scheduled to present the annual ten-year capital plan for board approval, with two versions of the capital projects document provided for review.
Dr. Strike was expected to present the 2026-2027 employee handbook with tracked changes for board consideration, including a memo explaining proposed modifications.

publicComment: A public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to approve the minutes from the July 15, 2026 meeting
Board was expected to vote on certified staff employment, resignations, and contract adjustments
Board was expected to approve the Treasurer's Report and Balance Sheet
Board was expected to consider and approve budget transfers and revisions

Board was expected to conduct second reading and vote on nine policies related to student supervision, job descriptions, communication devices, technology use, social media, volunteers, and abuse reporting
Board was expected to approve the Ten-Year Capital Plan annual submission
Board was expected to review and take action on the 2026-2027 Employee Handbook
title: Regular School Board Meeting - 2026-08-19
